note: Effects of each candidate alone, measured by the reference code (see candidate_effects.py docstring). Positive benefit = better. Hypothetical scenario options; not forecasts. `candidates` = the catalog offered to the planner (kept); `pruned` = entries removed from it, with the reason and the measured effect.

pruneRules.shuttle: removed when the measured population-wide effect is zero on every lens (car-only edges, wait longer than driving); the one shuttle with a measurable local effect is kept
pruneRules.staging: keep the 3 staging sites with the largest EMS p90 gain in the baseline context
pruneRules.connector: kept when it helps on any lens including freight
